fbx_format: Blender 7400 geometry-check exports, not Autodesk FBX2018 certification
excluded_from_missing_mesh_failures: __context_scene__ is an intentional background-only register placeholder
roundtrip_scope: Mesh count, triangle count, UV-layer count, world bbox and bidirectional vertex distance < 0.0001m. Does not prove shader appearance, special-shader UV nonoverlap, normals convention, collision/navigation or game import.
